title: Torsion-Motivated Early Dark Energy with an Onset Locked to Matter-Radiation Equality: Pre-Registered Tests on Planck, ACT, SPT-3G and DESI
description:
Promoting the Barbero-Immirzi parameter of Einstein-Cartan-Holst gravity to a field gives a canonical, ghost-free pseudoscalar. With an assumed potential V=\Lambda^4[1-\cos(\phi/F)]^3 it is axion-like early dark energy (EDE); we fix the peak of its energy fraction at matter-radiation equality, leaving two extra parameters, and test it with full Boltzmann codes and decision rules hashed before each fit. On Planck + ACT DR6 + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+ it improves on \LambdaCDM by \Delta\chi^2=-7.23; on SPT-3G D1 alone no version improves meaningfully (best \Delta\chi^2=-1.27). On all three CMB data sets combined with DESI DR2 and Pantheon+ it passes its pre-registered rule (\Delta\chi^2=-5.63, f_{\rm EDE}=0.070, H_0=70.15), but late evolving dark energy (w_0-w_a) fits better (\Delta\chi^2=-10.89; \DeltaAIC lower by 5.3). Because the initial angle is undefined when f_{\rm EDE}=0, the naive significances are upper estimates; a profile likelihood, a look-elsewhere correction and a joint early-plus-late fit are pre-registered and running. The data favour the flat-bottomed n=3 shape over n=2, which we show is not produced by the Nieh-Yan term or by natural instanton or anomaly potentials, and the equality lock cannot be derived from the minimal action. Two codes agree to 0.4 in \chi^2 and the field does not fragment. Fixed-number variants of the width and initial angle all fail. We outline a late-time alternative in which the same field, with the natural n=1 potential and a Planck-scale range, acts as thawing dark energy. We state which parts are derived, which are assumed, and which failed.

Version 3 adds Planck + ACT + SPT-3G combined tests (the locked model passes its rule; late w0-wa evolving dark energy fits better), the potential-power test, why geometry does not fix the potential or the lock, and a late-time outlook. Profile, look-elsewhere and early+late analyses are pre-registered and running. ancillary_v3.zip holds the code, fit outputs and pre-registration files.
